entities.name: Aubrey de Vere, 2nd Earl of Oxford
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aubrey de Vere, 2nd Earl of Oxford, hereditary Master Chamberlain of England, served in military campaigns under King Richard and King John. He was succeeded in the earldom by his brother, Robert de Vere, 3rd Earl of Oxford.
